Licence: CoinMarketCap data-api (undocumented, keyless): CMC's terms forbid redistribution without a licence. The repo is public, so the bundle is local disk only (in_git=False); rebuild it from this recipe.
cmc-historical-listings.schema: kind listing: value = {date (snapshot day), id, symbol, slug, name, cmcRank, price, volume24h, marketCap (USD), circulatingSupply, totalSupply, maxSupply, percentChange24h, percentChange7d, dateAdded, lastUpdated, platform (the token's chain, or None), flags (that snapshot's CMC tags marking stablecoins, wrapped, tokenized, staked or bridged assets)}; dead coins included (point-in-time ranking); price = the day's close (it equals CMC's daily OHLC close for the date; lastUpdated reads 23:59 UTC in 2017-2019 snapshots and 00:00 of the date in 2026 ones, a label quirk); observed_at = the date 23:59:59 UTC; available_at = the next day 00:00 UTC | kind snapshot: value = {date, n, limit}, one per date. Each date holds the top `limit` by cmcRank (MARKET CAP), not by volume: a volume ranking built from it can still miss very small-cap, wash-traded coins below that market-cap depth, and a coin that drops below the depth has no row (no exit price) that day (use cmc-coin-daily-<id> for it). FLAGS ARE SNAPSHOT-DATED and mostly empty before about 2020 (2018-06-10: 106 of 500 coins tagged, USDT and TUSD flags = []; 2021-05-16: WBTC tagged stablecoin), so exclusions must use a declared list of CMC ids (cmc_flags_latest drafts one from the newest tags; not point in time). CMC prices are cross-exchange VWAPs, volume24h includes wash trades, and CMC can revise history: near point in time, not vintage-stamped

cmc-daily-listings-2020.name: cmc-daily-listings-2020
cmc-daily-listings-2020.recipe: GET https://api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/cryptocurrency/listings/historical?date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&start=1&limit=500&convertId=2781 for every day of 2020 from 2017-11-01 (keyless data-api), merged by date via mandel.data.crypto_history.fetch_cmc_daily_listings. Licence: CoinMarketCap data-api (undocumented, keyless): CMC's terms forbid redistribution without a licence. The repo is public, so the bundle is local disk only (in_git=False); rebuild it from this recipe.
cmc-daily-listings-2020.schema: kind listing: value = {date (snapshot day), id, symbol, slug, name, cmcRank, price, volume24h, marketCap (USD), circulatingSupply, totalSupply, maxSupply, percentChange24h, percentChange7d, dateAdded, lastUpdated, platform (the token's chain, or None), flags (that snapshot's CMC tags marking stablecoins, wrapped, tokenized, staked or bridged assets)}; dead coins included (point-in-time ranking); price = the day's close (it equals CMC's daily OHLC close for the date; lastUpdated reads 23:59 UTC in 2017-2019 snapshots and 00:00 of the date in 2026 ones, a label quirk); observed_at = the date 23:59:59 UTC; available_at = the next day 00:00 UTC | kind snapshot: value = {date, n, limit}, one per date. Each date holds the top `limit` by cmcRank (MARKET CAP), not by volume: a volume ranking built from it can still miss very small-cap, wash-traded coins below that market-cap depth, and a coin that drops below the depth has no row (no exit price) that day (use cmc-coin-daily-<id> for it). FLAGS ARE SNAPSHOT-DATED and mostly empty before about 2020 (2018-06-10: 106 of 500 coins tagged, USDT and TUSD flags = []; 2021-05-16: WBTC tagged stablecoin), so exclusions must use a declared list of CMC ids (cmc_flags_latest drafts one from the newest tags; not point in time). CMC prices are cross-exchange VWAPs, volume24h includes wash trades, and CMC can revise history: near point in time, not vintage-stamped

cmc-daily-listings-2021.name: cmc-daily-listings-2021
cmc-daily-listings-2021.recipe: GET https://api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/cryptocurrency/listings/historical?date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&start=1&limit=500&convertId=2781 for every day of 2021 from 2017-11-01 (keyless data-api), merged by date via mandel.data.crypto_history.fetch_cmc_daily_listings. Licence: CoinMarketCap data-api (undocumented, keyless): CMC's terms forbid redistribution without a licence. The repo is public, so the bundle is local disk only (in_git=False); rebuild it from this recipe.
cmc-daily-listings-2021.schema: kind listing: value = {date (snapshot day), id, symbol, slug, name, cmcRank, price, volume24h, marketCap (USD), circulatingSupply, totalSupply, maxSupply, percentChange24h, percentChange7d, dateAdded, lastUpdated, platform (the token's chain, or None), flags (that snapshot's CMC tags marking stablecoins, wrapped, tokenized, staked or bridged assets)}; dead coins included (point-in-time ranking); price = the day's close (it equals CMC's daily OHLC close for the date; lastUpdated reads 23:59 UTC in 2017-2019 snapshots and 00:00 of the date in 2026 ones, a label quirk); observed_at = the date 23:59:59 UTC; available_at = the next day 00:00 UTC | kind snapshot: value = {date, n, limit}, one per date. Each date holds the top `limit` by cmcRank (MARKET CAP), not by volume: a volume ranking built from it can still miss very small-cap, wash-traded coins below that market-cap depth, and a coin that drops below the depth has no row (no exit price) that day (use cmc-coin-daily-<id> for it). FLAGS ARE SNAPSHOT-DATED and mostly empty before about 2020 (2018-06-10: 106 of 500 coins tagged, USDT and TUSD flags = []; 2021-05-16: WBTC tagged stablecoin), so exclusions must use a declared list of CMC ids (cmc_flags_latest drafts one from the newest tags; not point in time). CMC prices are cross-exchange VWAPs, volume24h includes wash trades, and CMC can revise history: near point in time, not vintage-stamped

cmc-daily-listings-2022.name: cmc-daily-listings-2022
cmc-daily-listings-2022.recipe: GET https://api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/cryptocurrency/listings/historical?date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&start=1&limit=500&convertId=2781 for every day of 2022 from 2017-11-01 (keyless data-api), merged by date via mandel.data.crypto_history.fetch_cmc_daily_listings. Licence: CoinMarketCap data-api (undocumented, keyless): CMC's terms forbid redistribution without a licence. The repo is public, so the bundle is local disk only (in_git=False); rebuild it from this recipe.
cmc-daily-listings-2022.schema: kind listing: value = {date (snapshot day), id, symbol, slug, name, cmcRank, price, volume24h, marketCap (USD), circulatingSupply, totalSupply, maxSupply, percentChange24h, percentChange7d, dateAdded, lastUpdated, platform (the token's chain, or None), flags (that snapshot's CMC tags marking stablecoins, wrapped, tokenized, staked or bridged assets)}; dead coins included (point-in-time ranking); price = the day's close (it equals CMC's daily OHLC close for the date; lastUpdated reads 23:59 UTC in 2017-2019 snapshots and 00:00 of the date in 2026 ones, a label quirk); observed_at = the date 23:59:59 UTC; available_at = the next day 00:00 UTC | kind snapshot: value = {date, n, limit}, one per date. Each date holds the top `limit` by cmcRank (MARKET CAP), not by volume: a volume ranking built from it can still miss very small-cap, wash-traded coins below that market-cap depth, and a coin that drops below the depth has no row (no exit price) that day (use cmc-coin-daily-<id> for it). FLAGS ARE SNAPSHOT-DATED and mostly empty before about 2020 (2018-06-10: 106 of 500 coins tagged, USDT and TUSD flags = []; 2021-05-16: WBTC tagged stablecoin), so exclusions must use a declared list of CMC ids (cmc_flags_latest drafts one from the newest tags; not point in time). CMC prices are cross-exchange VWAPs, volume24h includes wash trades, and CMC can revise history: near point in time, not vintage-stamped

cmc-daily-listings-2023.recipe: GET https://api.coinmarketcap.com/data-api/v3/cryptocurrency/listings/historical?date=<YYYY-MM-DD>&start=1&limit=500&convertId=2781 for every day of 2023 from 2017-11-01 (keyless data-api), merged by date via mandel.data.crypto_history.fetch_cmc_daily_listings. Licence: CoinMarketCap data-api (undocumented, keyless): CMC's terms forbid redistribution without a licence. The repo is public, so the bundle is local disk only (in_git=False); rebuild it from this recipe.
cmc-daily-listings-2023.schema: kind listing: value = {date (snapshot day), id, symbol, slug, name, cmcRank, price, volume24h, marketCap (USD), circulatingSupply, totalSupply, maxSupply, percentChange24h, percentChange7d, dateAdded, lastUpdated, platform (the token's chain, or None), flags (that snapshot's CMC tags marking stablecoins, wrapped, tokenized, staked or bridged assets)}; dead coins included (point-in-time ranking); price = the day's close (it equals CMC's daily OHLC close for the date; lastUpdated reads 23:59 UTC in 2017-2019 snapshots and 00:00 of the date in 2026 ones, a label quirk); observed_at = the date 23:59:59 UTC; available_at = the next day 00:00 UTC | kind snapshot: value = {date, n, limit}, one per date. Each date holds the top `limit` by cmcRank (MARKET CAP), not by volume: a volume ranking built from it can still miss very small-cap, wash-traded coins below that market-cap depth, and a coin that drops below the depth has no row (no exit price) that day (use cmc-coin-daily-<id> for it). FLAGS ARE SNAPSHOT-DATED and mostly empty before about 2020 (2018-06-10: 106 of 500 coins tagged, USDT and TUSD flags = []; 2021-05-16: WBTC tagged stablecoin), so exclusions must use a declared list of CMC ids (cmc_flags_latest drafts one from the newest tags; not point in time). CMC prices are cross-exchange VWAPs, volume24h includes wash trades, and CMC can revise history: near point in time, not vintage-stamped

Licence: CoinMarketCap data-api (undocumented, keyless): CMC's terms forbid redistribution without a licence. The repo is public, so the bundle is local disk only (in_git=False); rebuild it from this recipe.
cmc-daily-listings-2024.schema: kind listing: value = {date (snapshot day), id, symbol, slug, name, cmcRank, price, volume24h, marketCap (USD), circulatingSupply, totalSupply, maxSupply, percentChange24h, percentChange7d, dateAdded, lastUpdated, platform (the token's chain, or None), flags (that snapshot's CMC tags marking stablecoins, wrapped, tokenized, staked or bridged assets)}; dead coins included (point-in-time ranking); price = the day's close (it equals CMC's daily OHLC close for the date; lastUpdated reads 23:59 UTC in 2017-2019 snapshots and 00:00 of the date in 2026 ones, a label quirk); observed_at = the date 23:59:59 UTC; available_at = the next day 00:00 UTC | kind snapshot: value = {date, n, limit}, one per date. Each date holds the top `limit` by cmcRank (MARKET CAP), not by volume: a volume ranking built from it can still miss very small-cap, wash-traded coins below that market-cap depth, and a coin that drops below the depth has no row (no exit price) that day (use cmc-coin-daily-<id> for it). FLAGS ARE SNAPSHOT-DATED and mostly empty before about 2020 (2018-06-10: 106 of 500 coins tagged, USDT and TUSD flags = []; 2021-05-16: WBTC tagged stablecoin), so exclusions must use a declared list of CMC ids (cmc_flags_latest drafts one from the newest tags; not point in time). CMC prices are cross-exchange VWAPs, volume24h includes wash trades, and CMC can revise history: near point in time, not vintage-stamped

cmc-daily-listings-2025.schema: kind listing: value = {date (snapshot day), id, symbol, slug, name, cmcRank, price, volume24h, marketCap (USD), circulatingSupply, totalSupply, maxSupply, percentChange24h, percentChange7d, dateAdded, lastUpdated, platform (the token's chain, or None), flags (that snapshot's CMC tags marking stablecoins, wrapped, tokenized, staked or bridged assets)}; dead coins included (point-in-time ranking); price = the day's close (it equals CMC's daily OHLC close for the date; lastUpdated reads 23:59 UTC in 2017-2019 snapshots and 00:00 of the date in 2026 ones, a label quirk); observed_at = the date 23:59:59 UTC; available_at = the next day 00:00 UTC | kind snapshot: value = {date, n, limit}, one per date. Each date holds the top `limit` by cmcRank (MARKET CAP), not by volume: a volume ranking built from it can still miss very small-cap, wash-traded coins below that market-cap depth, and a coin that drops below the depth has no row (no exit price) that day (use cmc-coin-daily-<id> for it). FLAGS ARE SNAPSHOT-DATED and mostly empty before about 2020 (2018-06-10: 106 of 500 coins tagged, USDT and TUSD flags = []; 2021-05-16: WBTC tagged stablecoin), so exclusions must use a declared list of CMC ids (cmc_flags_latest drafts one from the newest tags; not point in time).
